source: The canal service needs an update for holders of existing Saturday repair appointments. From 7 to 21 August they must enter through Gate C, within the time printed on their booking. Weekday appointments still use Gate A. Staff discussed making Gate C permanent, but no decision was made. A rehearsal with staff used eight sample bookings; no customers took part.

idea.title: Gate C for existing Saturday canal repair bookings
idea.description: Explain that all appointments from 7 to 21 August use Gate C at any time during opening hours.
idea.audience: Holders of existing Saturday repair appointments
idea.rationale: The temporary notice may help appointment holders find the correct entrance.
idea.evidence: The stated gate, dates and unchanged booking time.
